Concerning number 7 he proclaimed "Dubitamus" ("we doubt it'). According to his biographer, "du Bois-Reymond was not the first to suggest that we could never fathom the ultimate nature of mind and matter, but his was the clearest voice of caution towards our modern faith in experiment."
